rows.definition: The explicit Go build tag selecting the experimental strict binary32 environment marker for V4.1 tail RoPE Rows and its software ABI tests. With Vulkan it selects a separate native archive; combining it with the indexer, BF16 or scalar-logit witness tag is a compile-time error.
rows.distinction: The tag controls Go source and archive selection. The native define controls strict loaded-module admission, and the linker token names the archive input. The marker additionally requires actual module modes and selected-device properties; the tag alone does not qualify hardware, enable ordinary production dispatch or remove host-boundary blockers.

rows.definition: The native compile-time define that requires the existing mandatory tail RoPE module to carry DenormPreserve, SignedZeroInfNanPreserve and RoundingModeRTE F32 modes with matching selected-device support and strict ABI/arithmetic-shape admission. It exposes the exact-environment and parser-test C symbols. The same define enables those modes in the unchanged GLSL arithmetic algorithm; ordinary builds retain their prior module policy.
rows.distinction: This selects native and shader compilation for an isolated witness profile. The Go tag selects its adapter and archive. It changes no ordinary registry membership, and source/module/archive build provenance remains separate from parser admission and physical qualification.

rows.definition: The exact cgo linker-option token selecting libfakvulkan_v41_tail_rope_exact_witness.a for the strict tail RoPE witness-tagged Go build. All five Vulkan archive selectors choose this input exclusively for that tag combination. Ordinary native archives lack the strict environment marker and parser-test symbols.
rows.distinction: This names the linker input, separately from the Go tag and native/shader define. The option alone does not prove linked bytes: reviewed build commands and artifact hashes bind immutable-artifact provenance. The existing Rows dispatch is reused and tail BF16 readback remains on the host.
